description: Backend foundation: schema + seed (must_change_password, password_changed_at, registration_application.password_hash, append-only audit_log + trigger, Lervyn 29/36, seeded audit rows), audit infrastructure (request context, model, service record/recordSafe), member-chosen registration passwords (public + desk) with strength validation, must_change_password enforcement (PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED), POST /auth/change-password with rate limit and JWT re-issue, BA reset sets the flag, grading notes hidden from students in remarkModel. Independent of the front end; FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 depend on it. Read .be-tmp/task2/plan2.md sections 2-5 first.
steps: First run `git status --short` and save the output to .be-tmp/task2/git-status-before.txt (read-only git).

src/utils/password.js checkStrength; src/validators/public.js registrationBase + password/confirmPassword + superRefine passwordRules (export both); src/validators/admin.js desk registration schema built from registrationBase.extend(...) + passwordRules; src/validators/auth.js changePassword.

acceptance_criteria: db.sql then seed.sql load twice on PGlite without error and SELECT count(*) FROM v_grading_conflict returns 0
UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE on audit_log raise the append-only error; INSERT works; seeded audit rows exist inside 2025-11-06..2027-11-06
GET /student/grading for S-001 shows sessions 29 of needSessions 36

POST /public/registrations without a valid password/confirmPassword (short, no digit, no letter, >72 bytes, equals email, mismatch) returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR; with a valid one the application row holds a bcrypt hash and no endpoint response contains the password or hash

After activation (auto or staff) the users row uses that hash, registration_application.password_hash is NULL, and the member signs in with member number or email plus the chosen password; no tempPassword in the response (except the NULL-hash fallback, which sets must_change_password)

A user with must_change_password=true can log in and call /auth/me and /auth/change-password but every other authenticated API returns 403 PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED; after change-password the flag is false and the new Set-Cookie works
change-password rejects wrong current (400 CURRENT_PASSWORD_INCORRECT), weak, reused and mismatched passwords, and returns 429 after CHANGE_PW_RATE_MAX failures
BA POST /admin/staff/:id/reset-password sets must_change_password and invalidates the target's old cookie
No student endpoint returns an instructor_remark of kind 'grading'

Run the ad-hoc script described in the last step against PGlite and confirm every assertion passes
